title: Yasargil reviewable surgical dataset enrichment record v2.0.0
description: One JSONL record is an auditable enhancement archive: original bytes and annotations, derivations, proposed claims, actual reviews, conversation alignment and separate case-level outcomes. JSON Schema checks structure, not factual correctness, reviewer authenticity, temporal exposure or training benefit. Semantic validation and the review protocol must establish those properties before a messages-only Unsloth export.

revision.description: Immutable revision identity. Parent revision links the previous record state; timestamps describe archive revision creation.

location.description: Resolvable asset location. Source-root/path policy and byte verification are enforced by the storage adapter.

asset.description: Byte-addressed original or derived asset. Original dataset bytes remain immutable; derived assets retain their ancestry.

locator.description: Locator syntax is determined by locator_type. CSV rows include the header as row 1; empty string is valid for a JSON document root or whole asset.

raw_value.description: Exact source value, preserved without normalization or interpretation; any valid JSON value is permitted.

annotation.description: Exact source annotation and its declared provenance. Original computed/model labels do not become manual ground truth by import or review.

frame.description: Frame order and timing are distinct. Unavailable timestamps are null; estimated sampling times must not be presented as original presentation timestamps.

parameters.description: Method-specific, serializable parameters. Preserve exact values; validation of method semantics is separate.

frame_selection.description: Selection provenance is independent of generation provenance. Offline selection does not establish an online selector; selection scores are not claim-quality scores.

parameters.description: Method-specific, serializable parameters. Preserve exact values; validation of method semantics is separate.

transformation.description: A reproducible derivation, with original inputs preserved. Model-generated additions instead identify their generation run.

generation_parameters.description: Method-specific, serializable parameters. Preserve exact values; validation of method semantics is separate.

generation_run.description: An actual generation receipt, not merely intended inputs. Request/response assets preserve exact request and output bytes, including supplied text, original annotations, reference excerpts and conversation context. This metadata is not itself model-visible.

region.description: Top-left origin, x rightward and y downward; coordinates refer to original image edges. Bounding-box order is x1,y1,x2,y2 and semantic validation requires positive area. Cropped/resized display coordinates must be mapped back through documented transformations.

evidence.description: Empty evidence is allowed for pending proposals so unsupported additions remain reviewable. Training eligibility requires semantic evidence/review checks; a reference alone does not establish support.

output_location.description: Zero-based [start_character,end_character) Unicode codepoint offsets into the exact text of one messages content block. Semantic validation verifies the range and correspondence to claim text.

claim.description: The smallest reviewable assertion. Origin and contribution remain explicit after acceptance; reexpressing an existing annotation is not a new verified observation. Rejected and superseded claims remain auditable.

conflict.description: Conflicting source values and claims remain available. Resolution points to actual adjudication; it does not erase the original discrepancy.

review.description: A completed human review event. Schema validity neither creates a review nor authenticates the reviewer. Applicable criteria and reviewer qualifications are enforced by the review protocol/training gate.

measurement.description: A measured, protocol-defined statistic supported by actual reviews. Fractions require explicit denominators; counts and durations do not manufacture a denominator. These are annotation/review measurements, not downstream model benefit or clinical efficacy.

case_outcome.description: A source-linked case-level endpoint with its own timing and missingness. A favorable outcome is not proof that a generated claim or an individual action was correct.

risk_comparison.description: A descriptive comparison for a measured endpoint. Semantic validation recomputes observed minus expected and verifies the matched endpoint, units, baseline provenance and prediction exposure.

patient_risk_adjustment.description: Patient baseline adjustment is a distinct research analysis. Claims of preoperative exposure, out-of-sample prediction and appropriate calibration require supporting evidence; these flags do not prove them.

image.description: Portable image reference resolved to its recorded asset by the projection/loader. JSON contains a string; runtime hydration supplies an RGB PIL image.

turn_link.description: The actual student-facing input contract for one user/assistant pair. Presence in archive metadata is not evidence that an item was included in the prompt. Cross-field validation checks exact messages, claims, image identities and causal cutoffs.

training_view.description: Canonical training projection plus alignment metadata. The Unsloth export is exactly {messages:[...]}; turn links, claims, provenance, reviews and case outcomes are not automatically placed in the prompt. Drafts may have no completed dialogue.

partition.description: Partition assignment references an actual manifest. Corpus-level checks must prevent shared grouping identities or identical source images from spanning train/evaluation partitions.

training_value.description: Links to comparative experiments measuring downstream training value. No per-record invented training-value score or causal clinical-effect claim is defined.
